Score WT (World Taekwondo) kyorugi (sparring), traditional poomsae (forms), and freestyle poomsae all in one app! Made by a taekwondo enthusiast for taekwondo enthusiasts.

Can be used for dojang/club training, collegiate teams, coaches, team trials, training referees and judges, preparing tournament volunteers, and/or assisting with scoring online tournaments. Includes built-in features designed to help educate athletes, parents, and tournament volunteers about competition-style taekwondo and scoring guidelines. Not intended for in-person, full-sized tournaments. Currently no feature for real time syncing with other devices or with a head table device.

SCORING
Score kyorugi, traditional poomsae, and freestyle poomsae using your device. Designed to mimic handheld scoring devices but with a clean, modern twist. App will adjust buttons onscreen if device is held sideways.

KEEP TRACK OF STANDINGS
Enter names of competitors and keep track of kyorugi matches and poomsae standings.

LEARNING MODE
Read information about how elements of a competition are scored when learning mode is turned on. Great for educating athletes, parents, instructors, volunteers and referees/judges-in-training. 

REF MODE
Access referee commands while using a scoring screen when ref mode is turned on. Great for training referees and instructors.

REFEREE DICTIONARY
Provides charts displaying referee commands in Anglicized Korean with corresponding English translations and hand signals, including gam-jeom signals.
